detail:
Full summary: Merged lane/02c-migration into foundation/v3; resolved the commands.ts and registry-count conflicts keeping both lanes' commands, and fixed a cross-lane admission non-monotonicity that wiped every projection on rebuild.
Decisions: [object Object]; Resolved src/core/commands.ts and test/core/command-registry.test.ts by keeping BOTH lanes' command sets rather than either side — registry now 41 commands (25 full-surface, 16 default), which is the true total with twining_exchange_status and twining_migrate_status
Findings: warning: EventStore.rebuild() re-journals every event with ingress hard-coded to 'import' (src/events/event-store.ts step 1 of rebuild), losing the originating ingress. Today ingress only feeds the journal reason string, so nothing depends on it — but any future rule keyed on ingress will silently differ between first admission and rebuild. The journal has no ingress column.; C21 A-REC-10 (derived-index rebuild is not data loss) is the assertion that catches admission non-monotonicity end-to-end; it passed in both lanes separately and only failed once 02b and 02c were merged. Cross-lane determinism defects are invisible to per-lane suites.
